hero.headline: Downtown has a new brand. Now make it *unmistakable.*
hero.lead: Your 2025–2027 strategic plan sets the bar: downtown should be “distinct in identity, celebrated in stories, and recognized for its energy and edge.” Hallpass can help turn that ambition into a story people see, remember, and act on.

photo.alt: A singer dances through the crowd at Beats on Bates in downtown Kalamazoo

concepts.headline: Make downtown’s stories *visible.*
concepts.lead: A connected publishing system, not one-off posts, could give visitors, residents, downtown businesses, and prospective tenants multiple ways into the same Downtown Kalamazoo story.

plan.quote: Downtown is *unmistakable*—distinct in identity, celebrated in stories, and recognized for its energy and edge.
plan.quote_source: Downtown Kalamazoo DDA/DEGA Strategic Plan 2025–2027, adopted August 18, 2025, Vibrant & Visible, p. 10
plan.outside_help_heading: The brand is live. The stories are next.
plan.outside_help_quote: The plan’s 2026 work plan calls for rolling out the brand “across key platforms” and beginning a “strategic communication plan” (p. 14), and its KPIs track “Growth in social media engagement (quarterly benchmarks)” (p. 15).

pov.people_line: We start with people: the owner who opened a shop on the Kalamazoo Mall, the ambassador who keeps every block clean and welcoming, the neighbor who never misses Beats on Bates.
